pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Collapsed Kingdom.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: The current setting blocks arrows; direct damage attributed to thrown potions and area-effect clouds is rejected separately. Sleep and a special transition state block normal damage. Let a transformation finish before returning to melee attacks.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. The current setting blocks arrows; direct damage attributed to thrown potions and area-effect clouds is rejected separately. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Corrupted Soul, Soul Great Sword. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Corrupted Eye. First record the branch victories: Bone Stalker, Overgrown Colossus. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
